description: I’m a solo builder with skills in math, logical modeling, and web development, creating Echoes of Discovery for middle-schoolers (ages 10–14). Using authentic NASA NSSDCA data, it guides students from Earth to the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space—covering all 13 historic hardware categories through interactive mechanics, sensory stories, scientific discoveries, and current operational status. Focused 1-person team with an active prototype; glad to connect with fellow space enthusiasts!
